summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by 3 E Network Technology Group Ltd reporting entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement with an institutional investor for a senior secured 8% OID convertible note of up to $1,300,000 and a warrant to buy up to 265,198 Class A ordinary shares at $5.00 per share. Initial closing for $1,000,000 note principal ($920,000 net) occurred May 1, 2026. Boustead Securities acted as placement agent. This is a standard PIPE financing, not a special situation.
